description: Decode and audit an HTTP 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64 or JSON) for accepts[], Base USDC terms, extensions.bazaar schema validity, and resource.url alignment ($0.50 USDC on Base). Unpaid calls return 402 terms. Use this instead of oracle_review_mcp when debugging a single 402 payload before facilitator settlement.

challenge_b64_or_json.description: Raw base64-encoded PAYMENT-REQUIRED header value or its decoded JSON string.

resource_url.description: Optional canonical HTTPS URL of the protected endpoint being challenged.

name: oracle_diagnose_402

citations.description: Coinbase CDP validate and Bazaar doc links.

implementation_prompt.description: Step-by-step repair instructions for the challenged endpoint.

risk.description: Risk warning for malformed indexing or wasted settlement gas.

verdict.description: Diagnosis code such as challenge_shape_ok, missing_bazaar_extension, or missing_accepts.

wisdom.description: Actionable explanation of what passed or failed in the 402 handshake.
